title: `TableFormat` defaults to `Blast` while `--tbl-format` defaults to nail
body:
`TableFormat` in nail/src/args.rs derives `Default` with `#[default]` on `Blast`. `--tbl-format` defaults to `nail`, and the help says so. `IoArgs` derives `Default` too, so `IoArgs::default()` would carry `Blast`. Nothing in nail calls `IoArgs::default()` today, so the mismatch has no effect yet.

## Proposal

Move `#[default]` to `Nail`.
